title: Create a sheet with the right title block and place a floor plan on it
task: Issue a plan on a sheet: find a title block FamilySymbol (OST_TitleBlocks), ViewSheet.Create with it, pick an existing floor plan that Viewport.CanAddViewToSheet accepts (View.Duplicate one if all are placed), place it with Viewport.Create and verify with ViewSheet.GetAllPlacedViews. To change a title block, create the sheet with the right type; never set SheetTitleBlockId on a live sheet.

pitfalls.symptom: Revit crashes (process exits) when a sheet's title block is changed by script.
pitfalls.cause: Setting ViewSheet.SheetTitleBlockId (or swapping the title block instance's type) on a live sheet is unsafe (issue #113).
pitfalls.fix: Create the sheet with the right title block type in ViewSheet.Create and move the viewports; never set SheetTitleBlockId on an existing sheet.

pitfalls.symptom: Viewport.Create throws ArgumentException 'viewId cannot be added to the ViewSheet'.
pitfalls.cause: The view is already placed on a sheet (the default template's own sheets hold several), or it is a schedule/legend.
pitfalls.fix: Check Viewport.CanAddViewToSheet first; create a fresh view, or duplicate the placed one with View.Duplicate.

pitfalls.symptom: search_functions('create sheet place view') never surfaced ViewSheet.Create.
pitfalls.fix: The members of this how-to are the route: ViewSheet.Create then Viewport.Create.
